title: Personal Portrait
summary: Oskar’s reward portrait grants Painted Hero inspiration.

fields.Quest reward: Complete Free the Artist at Lady Jannath’s Estate. Receiving it gives Painted Hero inspiration to Folk Heroes.
fields.Appearance: The subject is the speaking party member. Dialogue controls the portrait title, with a unique Bard option.
fields.Base value: 1500 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
